source_name: Mixed trade-press sources (Mundus Agri / IndexBox market reports) — LOWER CONFIDENCE, see notes
year: 2024-25 (volume); 2024 (value figures, product-use framed rather than plain country totals)
notes: LOW CONFIDENCE — flagged for follow-up before use in a priced blog post. Export volume for FY2024-25 was reported as a wide, inconsistent range (208,000 to 330,000 MT) across sources, which is too imprecise to publish as a headline number. The three country values (China $52.5M 'for desserts', US $37.5M 'for supplements', Japan $22.5M 'for seasonings') come from a blog-style market report that frames them by end-use rather than as a clean customs-data country breakdown, and states these three markets capture '75% of shipments' without defining the base. Verified fact: India became the world's largest sesame-seed exporter in 2023 (multiple corroborating sources). Recommend re-querying APEDA AgriExchange or DGCI&S TradeStat directly for a cleaner FY2024-25 country-value table before this anchors a blog post.
